name: opamp-preamp
prompt: Build a non-inverting op-amp amplifier with a gain of 10, running from a 9 V supply, input and output on screw terminals.
notes: Analog with a gain equation: 1 + Rf/Rg = 10, so the ratio must be 9:1 from E24 values. opamp_input_floating fires if either input is left unreferenced, and missing_supply_decoupling applies to the analog rail.
